title: Evaluation-normalized open and closed derived Hom comparison maps
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. On schemes use the ordinary unbounded module-object derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], tensor and internal Hom [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. For an open immersion j, use supportPullback, its canonical alpha transport, j! and Rj*. Define the open derived adjunction by transport from j! adjoint to upperStar. Define the open projection as the adjoint of tensoring its unit followed by the inverse canonical pullback-tensor comparison [def-sfb-condensed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. For a closed immersion i whose module direct image preserves finite colimits, define the derived pullback/image adjunction termwise and its projection as the unit followed by image of the pullback-tensor comparison and tensor of the closed counit. Define openSupportHomMap by successive open, tensor-Hom and pullback/image transposes of projection followed by evaluation. For complementary i,j with j quasi-compact define closedSupportHomMap, given an inverse-direction closed projection χ, by the same tensor-Hom and two support adjunction transposes [det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction]. These are the explicit maps in the source calculation, without any invertibility claim. The termwise closed constructions take this exactness as an explicit typeclass argument. In closedSupportHomMap the complementary quasi-compact open immersion supplies it by closedSupport_lowerStarExact [det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction], scoped over the entire type and construction, so that no additional hypothesis is imposed on complementary pairs.

lean.statement: def openSupportHomMap {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (L : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ U)) (N : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ X)) : ((derivedHom Λ X).obj (op ((openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj L))).obj N ⟶ (lowerStar Λ j).rightDerivedFunctor.obj (((derivedHom Λ U).obj (op L)).obj ((supportPullback Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj N))
